headline: US mortgage rates hit highest since October as war keeps bond yields up, MBA says
summary: The rate on the most popular US home loan surged by the most in 11 months to the highest since October, according to the MBA. Rising oil prices from the Iran war fanned inflation fears and pushed up Treasury yields.
why: Mortgage rates track long-term Treasury yields and shape housing demand, so they are a key gauge of US consumer credit conditions.
